D767 north exit of the roundabout – start of the straight
D767 – end of the steep first kilometre
Mûr-de-Bretagne – finish line on the D767 (false flat before the 293 m top)

notes: Côte de Mûr-de-Bretagne as used for the Tour finishes (2011, 2015, 2018, 2021, 2025): the dead-straight D767 climbing north from the roundabout with the N164, just north of Mûr-de-Bretagne village, towards Saint-Gilles-Vieux-Marché. Tour figure 2 km at 6.9 % with the first km at almost 10 %; cols-cyclisme gives 2.2 km +144 m to the 293 m top. km 0 = the D767/N164 roundabout (DEM 151 m; app startElevationM 146). DEM along the routed road: km 0-1 9.4 %, km 1-2 4.4 % (app 9.8 / 4.0), ~289 m at km 2.0. The finish line is placed 2.0 km up the D767 from the roundabout (official climb length to the line) on the false flat ~250 m before the actual top (293 m at km 2.25); the exact line position is not published, so the finish is medium confidence. Note: the climb does NOT end in the village - Mûr-de-Bretagne village (~145 m) lies below the foot; the app landmark 'Ortseingang Mûr-de-Bretagne' at 1.5 km has no real counterpart (open fields).
